journeys.name: evaluation crew spacing
journeys.result: A 36-student crew, a two-student crew, A terra and Non assegnati rendered without horizontal overflow. Across all 35 adjacent pairs in the large crew, the member gap changed from 24 px to 12 px; the gaps between all groups changed from 92 px to 100 px.

journeys.name: note editor and exact session navigation
journeys.result: A multiline synthetic note remained editable at 320 px/200%, with all editor children inside the panel and no page overflow at 320, 390 or 412 px. A session opened from the student history selected sun-am in Valutazioni; its back action returned to that student's profile.

limitations: The native textarea drag handle is not exposed by the mobile browser emulation; the test verifies its vertical-resize CSS and that multiline content and controls remain within the panel.
